teach.goal: Como não traduzir palavra por palavra.

group: Compare erro e forma natural: When I arrived, he making bread. → When I arrived, he was making bread. | I buyed a loaf. → I bought a loaf. | Were you eat when I called? → Were you eating when I called?.

facts.label: Past progressive e when
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e o passado simples para a ação curta: When I arrived, the baker was making bread.

facts.label: Passado contínuo
facts.sub: Para uma ação em andamento no passado, use was/were + -ing: The baker was making bread. Use was com I, he, she e it. Use were com you, we e they.

facts.label: Quando
facts.sub: Use when para ligar duas ações: When I arrived, the baker was making bread. A ação longa fica com was/were + -ing. A ação curta e rápida fica no passado simples.

mini.pt: Quando cheguei, {o padeiro estava fazendo pão|o padeiro estava assando bolos|o padeiro estava limpando}.

mini.en: Yes. {Many people were waiting|Two people were waiting|Three friends were waiting} when I opened the door.
mini.pt: Estava. {Muita gente esperava|Duas pessoas esperavam|Três amigos esperavam} quando abri a porta.

mini.en: I bought {a loaf and two buns|a cake and a pie|a loaf and a bun}. The oven was still hot when I paid.
mini.pt: Comprei {um pão e dois pãezinhos|um bolo e uma torta|um pão e um pãozinho}. O forno ainda estava quente quando paguei.

mini.en: Yes, I was {eating a bun|eating a sandwich|drinking tea} on the bench.
mini.pt: Estava, sim. Eu {comia um pãozinho|comia um sanduíche|tomava chá} no banco.

facts.label: Perguntas
facts.sub: Para perguntar sobre uma ação em andamento, coloque was ou were antes do sujeito: Was the shop busy? What was the baker doing? A resposta curta é Yes, he was.

facts.label: Comprando
facts.sub: Para falar da compra, use o passado simples: I bought a loaf. I paid. I left. Buy vira bought, pay vira paid e leave vira left. São verbos irregulares muito comuns.

compare.ask: When I arrived, he was making bread.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Quando cheguei, ele fazia pão”, com o imperfeito.
compare.tip: Diga: “When I arrived, he was making bread.”
compare.us: Em inglês: was/were + -ing para a ação em andamento e passado simples para a que a interrompe. Diga When I arrived, he was making bread.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Was making talks about an action in progress.
After when, we always use the future.
items.why: In a past story, we use the past.

items.s: “I was eating when you called” is correct.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.

answers: Was making talks about an action in progress. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
After when, we always use the future. → Falso (In a past story, we use the past.)
“I was eating when you called” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
